document_metadata.document_name: HDFC Bank Limited - Unaudited Standalone Financial Results for the Quarter Ended September 30, 2026 (Q2 FY27)

official_filing_text: HDFC Bank Limited declared its unaudited standalone financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 (Q2 FY27) on October 17, 2026. The Bank reported standalone net profit of Rs 19,510 crore for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Total deposits grew at 18.8% YoY to reach Rs 30,40,000 crore, while gross advances grew at 16.3% YoY, progressing the glide path to moderate the credit to deposit ratio. The Credit to Deposit (C/D) ratio improved to 96.0% as of September 30, 2026, compared to 98.4% in the prior year period. Gross non-performing assets (GNPA) stood at 1.11% of gross advances as on September 30, 2026, as against 1.24% as on September 30, 2025. Net non-performing assets (NNPA) were at 0.37% of net advances as on September 30, 2026. Total Capital Adequacy Ratio (CAR) as per Basel III guidelines was 18.9% against regulatory requirement of 11.5%, with Tier 1 capital ratio at 17.5%. The Bank recorded annualised credit costs of 0.45% for the quarter. Total net worth stood at Rs 6,07,600 crore with 15.39 billion equity shares outstanding. The Board approved the succession transition with Anup Bagchi appointed to take charge as Managing Director and CEO on October 27, 2026.
